pages.text: $(l)Goety$() is dark magic: wands and foci powered by souls, rituals at dark altars, and servants raised from the dead.$(br2)Its focus wand is on $(l)Z$(), the focus wheel on $(l)=$(), the focus bag on $(l)0$(). Its own guidebook explains the rites. Some of Goety's lords are among the worst things in this world.
